regional_gradient_finding: Across the five states with statewide LANDIS trajectories, three regimes confirmed: West (WA v2.0) cuts about in half (ratio 0.55, revised from v1.0's 0.33 with the new per-species vector); Great Lakes (MN/WI/MI) cuts 1.5 to 1.7-fold (ratios 0.59-0.67); Northeast (ME) lifts 32 percent (ratio 1.32). The year-100 carbon ratio matches the state median ANPP theta within 0.10 for all five states (Great Lakes match within 0.05; WA v2.0 matches within 0.07; ME within 0.02). The per-species correction at the small scale propagates coherently to the state-aggregate carbon at the large scale.

calibration_clusters.scheme: 13-cluster CONUS scheme based on empirical species-pool overlap (see docs/conus_ecoregion_clusters.md)

methodology.novel_finding: Three-mode calibration degeneracy pathology (active-growth, empty-aggregator, sample-size)

pathology_taxonomy.active_growth: very low theta -> near-zero growth -> trivial IC fit; guard: active-growth fraction >= 0.50
pathology_taxonomy.empty_aggregator: per-plot pipeline failure -> empty per_plot.csv -> LL=0 default; guard: non-empty per_plot.csv
pathology_taxonomy.sample_size: few successful pairs -> trivially small LL magnitude -> CMA-ES misled; guard: MIN_N_PAIRS >= 300, harvester uses per-plot LL on near-full-n candidates
